A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same SpatialViz-Bench study and contain readable main text and Appendices A–F. Full text and rendered-page comparisons establish that differences are confined to pages 1 and 3; the remaining 66 pages match.

before.justification: v5 reports original evaluations of 27 MLLMs, a human study, prompting experiments and error analyses. Table 2 reports Gemini-2.5-pro at 44.66% accuracy and human performance at 82.46%, with further results in Appendix F.

after.justification: v7 retains these original model evaluations, human results, robustness experiments and error analyses in Section 4 and Appendix F.

M1.justification: The Python/FreeCAD generation pipeline, manual construction of Mechanical System questions and task-generation algorithms in Appendix B are unchanged. No algorithm, model component or inference procedure is revised.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same 1,180-problem benchmark covering 12 tasks across four spatial sub-abilities, including the DeepCAD-based projection items. Task variants and the evaluated human population remain unchanged.

E2.justification: The same 27 MLLMs, text-only Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct, random baseline and human comparison remain in Table 2. Comparator membership also matches within the prompting, robustness and supplementary comparisons.

E3.justification: Section 4.1 and Appendix E retain the same zero-shot protocols, CoT/non-CoT prompts, accuracy metric and answer-extraction procedures. The human evaluation still uses eight participants solving 72 problems each without external aids.

E4.justification: The CoT ablation, prompt and extraction-rule robustness checks, difficulty-sensitivity analysis, error analysis and Gemini-2.5-pro case studies are unchanged in Section 4 and Appendices E–F.

E5.justification: Both retain the same 95% Wilson confidence intervals, CoT significance tests, difficulty-gradient significance analysis and inter-annotator agreement reporting. No repeated-run, seed or uncertainty-estimation information changes.

E6.justification: All reported numerical results and qualitative findings match, including the appendix tables and case studies. Table 2 retains Gemini-2.5-pro at 44.66%, o1 at 41.36% and human performance at 82.46% under the same reported settings.

T1.justification: The cognitive definitions and mathematical reasoning embedded in task construction and Appendix B.4's algorithms are unchanged. No formal assumptions, derivations or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same claims about benchmark novelty, scalable generation, the model–human performance gap and perceptual/spatial-transformation bottlenecks.

C2.justification: Sections 4.2–4.3 and Appendix F retain the same interpretations of CoT degradation, limitations of model scaling, spatial failure mechanisms and the clues supplied by multiple-choice answers.

D1.justification: The first-page code link changes from wangst0181/Spatial-Visualization-Benchmark to wangst0181/SpatialViz-Bench, revising the documented access address. The data link, pseudocode, hardware and evaluation details are unchanged. The PDFs do not establish changes in code contents or availability.

R1.justification: Section 2, Appendix A and the references are unchanged, preserving the same cited works and research positioning. The updated publication-status notice does not revise the scientific relationship to prior work.

P1.justification: v7 adds Yuchen Li to the author list, revises affiliations and corresponding authors, and replaces the preprint notice with an ICLR 2026 publication notice. Scientific prose and section organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Figure 2 retains its 12-task overview but changes colors, borders, label placement and example rendering; the split 'View 2' label is corrected. The first-page author and affiliation layout also changes. Other figures, tables and appendix layouts match.

improvement.justification: The scientific argument, experiments, statistical support and appendices remain unchanged. The administrative updates, revised code address and Figure 2 restyling do not establish a meaningful overall quality improvement or decline; the PDFs provide no evidence that the link update improves resource access.
